task_definition.description: Browser automation with automatic Playwright browser installation

compute_logic.code:
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import os

# Install Playwright browser binaries if needed
# (Playwright Python package is auto-installed by Corebrum)
try:
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    # Check if browsers are installed by trying to list them
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, '-m', 'playwright', 'install', '--dry-run', 'chromium'],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    # If dry-run suggests installation needed, install it
    if 'chromium' in result.stdout.lower() or result.returncode != 0:
        print('Installing Chromium browser...', file=sys.stderr)
        subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'playwright', 'install', 'chromium'])
except ImportError:
    # Playwright not installed - Corebrum should auto-install it
    print('Playwright not found - will be auto-installed by Corebrum', file=sys.stderr)
    import subprocess
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', 'playwright'])
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, '-m', 'playwright', 'install', 'chromium'])

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        
        await page.goto('https://corebrum.com', wait_until='networkidle')
        
        result = {
            'message': 'Browser automation with auto-install successful',
            'title': await page.title(),
            'url': page.url,
            'browser_installed': True
        }
        
        await browser.close()
        return result

result = asyncio.run(main())
print(json.dumps(result))
